name: Craigslist All-in-One
description: Orchestrated Craigslist search-listing scraper. Guided cities x categories x queries expansion with price / hasPic / sort filters, automatic pagination, structured ListingSummary output, stable per-listing dedup and Dataset projections. Phase 1: search listings only (no detail pages).

searchQueries.label: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Optional keywords. Empty produces one browse seed per city x category.

hasPic.label: Has image
hasPic.description: Only listings that declare an image.

advancedSearchUrl.label: Advanced search URL
advancedSearchUrl.description: API-only. A single https://*.craigslist.org/search/... URL. Mutually exclusive with the guided fields.

reviewNotes: Craigslist all-in-one orchestrated template (Phase 1: search listing scraper).
